lines: Box CEO Aaron Levie argues AI agents let teams of 3–10 people match the output of organizations about 20 times their size, eroding incumbents' resource advantage as founders shift from doing the work to orchestrating and reviewing agents.
As execution costs like code and marketing assets approach zero, he says value moves to strategic clarity, product taste and spotting real market opportunities.

Cutting the cost of labor-heavy work by 90%+ creates demand for services that weren't economical before; in his view AI's ROI is currently far higher in high-stakes enterprise tasks than in consumer apps.

He sees a 'matrix' of opportunities in specialized agents for every job function in every industry, best built by pairing technical founders with domain experts — but stresses distribution and owning the customer relationship still decide who wins.
title: The New Startup Playbook | Box CEO Aaron Levie
